Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE genuinely transparent production sprite atlas of six small wearable accessories for a cream PAPER-layered bunny pompom mascot. Exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows: each COLUMN is one accessory, each ROW is its camera orientation. No mascot, head, body, skin, animal, mannequin, text, labels, borders or backgrounds. Every accessory is isolated fully within its tile with generous transparent safe gutters.
Columns left to right: 1 rounded thin warm-brown SUNGLASSES with translucent smoky-amber lenses and a tiny lemon-yellow hinge detail; 2 tiny soft lavender BERET with a cream band and small butter-yellow star pin; 3 peach-pink satin BOW with two rounded loops, center knot and short tails; 4 butter-yellow STAR BROOCH with a tiny sage leaf at its side; 5 small curved FLOWER CROWN of three cream-white daisies, yellow centers and a slim sage-green leaf band; 6 small golden LEMON SATCHEL with a short sage-green shoulder strap, rounded lemon pouch and one leaf. Keep each item's design, colors and physical construction the SAME in all four views.
Rows top to bottom: FRONT straight-on symmetric view; RIGHT THREE-QUARTER view with believable depth and foreshortening; RIGHT SIDE profile view, narrow actual depth; BACK view showing actual reverse surfaces (for sunglasses the rear-facing lens backs and temple arms, beret reverse band, bow reverse knot, star pin clasp, flower band reverse, satchel rear and strap).
Warm cozy high-quality small game cutout art: clean fine taupe outlines, rounded matte forms, restrained cel shading and gentle cream highlights. Match line weight and pastel warmth across all24 tiles. These are actual wearable cutouts, NOT items inside badges or decorative frames. Sunglasses remain open wearable glasses, hat is tiny and leaves a bunny's two ears unobstructed when attached. No floor shadows or detached particles. True transparent alpha around every item.
